business_problem: Philips needed to expand AI from specialist teams into broad, trusted employee use so the company could reduce administrative burden in healthcare workflows without violating regulatory, privacy, and safety expectations.
solution_summary: Philips is using ChatGPT and ChatGPT Enterprise as the front door for a company-wide AI literacy program that starts with safe internal work and aims toward clinical workflow improvement. The rollout began by training executives hands-on, launching a company-wide challenge for employees to propose use cases, and channeling existing curiosity about OpenAI tools into approved experimentation rather than shadow usage. Low-risk internal workflows became the first proving ground, with responsible-AI principles, transparency, fairness, and human oversight formalized before the company moved closer to patient-impacting scenarios. Employee prompts and workflow ideas now flow through governed ChatGPT environments, and the next phase is shifting from individual productivity gains into workflow-level automation and agent-supported processes, especially those that can return time to clinicians. This makes AI literacy itself an operational capability rather than a side initiative.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides the baseline AI interface employees use to learn, experiment, and begin applying AI to work.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Supplies the governed enterprise environment that increased adoption momentum across the organization.

data_flow: Employee use cases and internal workflow tasks enter ChatGPT environments under responsible-AI policies, successful patterns are expanded across the organization, and the next stage routes those capabilities into workflow-level automation focused on reducing clinical administrative work.
business_outcome: Philips broadened AI literacy across a 70,000-person workforce, created trust for governed experimentation, and set up a path toward healthcare workflows that return more time to clinicians and patients.
